decision: REJECT prototype1; no integration or propagation
reason: Actual exported painted oblique view has severe striped UV stretching on steep contour ramps; clay confirms isolated plaque-like masses and deep rectangular bed; reduced front is darker and less readable than baseline.
technical: Continuous band audit strengthened with pairwise no-interior-overlap and per-original-face coverage; this is separate from failed art gate.
